description: This file defines a template class 'ParserType' for parsing text streams with various states and options, along with classes 'TextParser' and 'PathParser' for text and path parsing respectively. It includes external headers related to enumeration, key-value pairs, number handling, optional types, portability, and range management, indicating its role in a core parsing module within the WPEFramework project.

classes.name: ParserType
classes.description: A template class for parsing streams of text with various states, supporting operations like collecting words, lines, handling escape sequences, and pass-through streams, parameterized by terminator and handler types.

classes.name: TextParser
classes.description: A class for parsing text fragments, providing methods to read text, skip characters, validate content, and extract numbers, enumerations, key-value pairs, and ranges.

classes.name: PathParser
classes.description: A class for parsing filesystem paths into drive, path, filename, basename, and extension components.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the parser state to initial conditions.

methods.name: Position
methods.description: Returns the current position in the stream.

methods.name: CollectWord
methods.description: Sets the parser state to collect a word.

methods.name: CollectWord
methods.description: Sets the parser state to collect a word with a specified split character.

methods.name: CollectWord
methods.description: Sets the parser state to collect a word with a specified case state.

methods.name: CollectWord
methods.description: Sets the parser state to collect a word with a specified split character and case state.

methods.name: CollectLine
methods.description: Sets the parser state to collect a line.

methods.name: CollectLine
methods.description: Sets the parser state to collect a line with a specified case state.

methods.name: FlushLine
methods.description: Flags the parser to flush the current line.

methods.name: PassThrough
methods.description: Sets the parser to pass through a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a stream of bytes into parser state, handling pass-through, line flushing, whitespace skipping, and token parsing.

methods.name: ReadText
methods.description: Reads text from a fragment, delimited by specified characters.

methods.name: Skip
methods.description: Skips a specified number of characters or positions.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Finds specified characters in the text fragment.

methods.name: SkipWhiteSpace
methods.description: Skips whitespace characters.

methods.name: SkipLine
methods.description: Skips to the end of the current line.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the fragment against a comparison string, case-sensitive or insensitive.

methods.name: ReadNumber
methods.description: Reads a number of specified type from the fragment.

methods.name: ReadEnumerate
methods.description: Reads an enumeration value from the fragment.

methods.name: ReadKeyValuePair
methods.description: Reads a key-value pair from the fragment.

methods.name: ReadRange
methods.description: Reads a range of numbers from the fragment.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a text fragment into path components.
